data.title: 红莲 · 旅栈床榻的真丝吊带舒展
data.description: 深夜客栈木窗微开，清凉夜风携着竹香拂入。红莲换上轻便舒适的深红细吊带单衣侧坐在榻榻米上，雪白的长马尾松散垂在光滑的裸肩旁。名刀静静横放膝前，平日凌厉锋芒的浪人剑客此刻神色极为惬意，金眸半敛，一手轻抚着温润的剑鞘，转头向你展露出毫无防备的动人微笑。
data.location: tranquil traditional wooden inn room beside moonlit sliding window
data.action: sitting on tatami with sword resting on lap, crimson silk camisole top, long white ponytail draped over shoulder, relaxed affectionate gaze at viewer
data.lighting: cool blue moonlight blending with warm paper lantern glow
data.mood: poetic wandering serenity, unguarded romantic warmth
data.promptProse: Seated upon a tatami mat in moonlight with her katana resting across her knees, Scarlet wears a soft crimson camisole. Her white hair cascades over bare shoulders as she smiles with serene, unburdened warmth.
data.animaCaption: Scarlet sitting on tatami in a crimson camisole with her katana under moonlight.
